summary.name: Napkin AI
summary.one_liner: Napkin AI is a visual communication platform that turns pasted or imported text into diagrams, flowcharts, mind maps, infographics, data charts, and presentation slides.
summary.what_it_does: Napkin takes pasted, written, or imported text (including PPT, DOC, PDF, HTML, and MD files) and generates a set of relevant visuals such as flowcharts, mind maps, infographics, diagrams, and data charts. The user picks the visual that fits best, then edits colors, fonts, layouts, icons, and individual elements. Napkin Slides is a related feature that builds a full presentation deck from ideas, collaborating with the user before generating. Finished visuals can be exported as PNG, PDF, PPT, or SVG. Teams can share a Teamspace, co-edit in real time, and comment on visuals and slides.
notable: Generates visuals directly from text without prompt writing
Fully editable outputs including colors, fonts, and individual elements
Shared Teamspace with real-time co-editing and commenting
caveats: Free plan has weekly AI credits; PPT and SVG export and custom branding require paid Plus or Pro plans
Visual generation is not yet available on mobile; mobile is for viewing and editing presentations
Mobile platform named as available, but the page only says mobile for viewing and editing slides/existing work
